programs.title: Chroniques D'en Haut:2024-2025 E20 -Hautes-Alpes, Travel Through Time
programs.desc: In the Hautes-Alpes, on the border between alpine and Mediterranean climate, the Buech is a massif full of secrets. The many remains of abandoned villages bear witness to the difficult living conditions in the mountains. But thanks to the will of a few, remote and difficult-to-reach valleys find a second life.

programs.title: Generation F S1E7 -Merigot Sanzay (Paris)/Mathilde Granveau (Vietnam)
programs.desc: In Paris, Richard Orlinski meets Diane, a high-warp tapestry artist, who has taken the name Merigot Sanzay. The artist revisits this ancestral French craft by giving it a modern touch. Installed in a workshop-boutique, she creates abstract wall works inspired by photographs. The journey continues in Vietnam, in Da Nang, which inspires painter Mathilde Granveau. Her universe combines geometric abstractions and ethnic motifs from Vietnamese minorities, expressed through canvases or urban wall frescoes.

programs.desc: Alessandra Montagne reveals the secrets of a Charente gastronomic institution with a long history: jonchee. She heads to Saint-Nazaire-sur-Charente, where the tradition of jonchee has endured. On today's menu: reinventing jonchee like a burrata, in an original savory recipe combining tradition and modernity.

programs.title: Les Chefs ! S14E10
programs.desc: The finalists cook their dream menus, inspired by the most significant moments of their lives. At the end of this ultimate challenge, the judges must decide...

programs.title: Echappees Belles S19E24 -The Charm Of A Winter In Corsica
programs.desc: Winter in Corsica is an invitation to discover an island with a beating heart, far from the summer crowds. A season when the true Corsican soul is revealed, between preserved traditions and moments of shared conviviality. The ideal time to appreciate the true Corsican art of living and its ancestral traditions.

programs.title: Curieux Begin:16-2 E11 -Canada From East To West
programs.desc: A tribute to Canadian Francophonie with guinea fowl breast, roasted cauliflower, mussels, and butter tarts. With chefs Etienne Croteau and John Winter Russell, singer Damien Robitaille, and artist Edith Butler.
